profile.title: About
profile.description: Three internships, three different stacks: PHP Laravel, C# .NET, Python Django. Each time: read the existing code before writing mine, understand the choices before questioning them. I build backends that do what they are supposed to do, without over-engineering.
profile.highlight: What sets me apart: I ask questions before opening a file. I would rather lose ten minutes in a meeting than two days fixing a misunderstanding.

softSkills.title: In practice

softSkills.learning: I learn by doing, not by watching tutorials
